## Using it

```python
from latincy_preprocess.lorem import is_lorem, lorem_score

lorem_score("Duis pharetra suscipit orci, vel condimentum erat.")
```

```bash
python -m latincy_preprocess.lorem cc100.txt -o kept.txt --dropped dropped.tsv --report report.json
```
